leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: moderately visible pinnate veins; about 6–9 pairs per side, fairly evenly spaced, slightly arcuate toward the margin

traits.notes: Leaves appear simple and entire with an elliptic to lanceolate shape (no lobes or teeth visible along margins); leaves are clustered near the shoot apex (gives appearance of a pseudo-whorl, though individual node attachments are not clearly visible); some leaves show small holes and minor missing margin segments (discrete areas of lamina loss visible); seedling is growing adjacent to rock and woody debris (stone surface and fallen wood clearly visible near stem); a bright pink tag is tied around the lower stem (artificial ribbon-like material encircling stem base).
